accounts.name: calendar
docs: Owner and type are checked by the loader; only the admin can append.

accounts.name: policy
docs: Gap Cover for the upcoming closure, if bought: the loan keeps max LTV through the Bell window.

accounts.name: inventory
docs: The pool's inventory of this collateral (backstop purchases).

accounts.name: inventory_state
docs: The books of that inventory: quantity, cost and mark (F-4.5e).

accounts.name: book
docs: The market's auction book (may not exist: no auction ever ran).

accounts.name: auction
docs: The closure's REOPEN auction, if one was created.

accounts.name: risk_set
docs: The upcoming closure's risk set (PRECLOSE target LTV); any of the market's sets otherwise.

accounts.name: policy
docs: The loan's Gap Cover for the upcoming closure; must not exist for a pre-close sale.

accounts.name: escrow
docs: Escrowed withdrawal shares and minted-but-unclaimed deposit shares.

accounts.name: share_escrow
docs: Holds the shares of queued redeem requests.

accounts.name: dead_shares
docs: Receives the 1e3 dead shares of the first deposit; nothing can move them out.

accounts.name: risk_set
docs: The risk set of the epoch's closure type.

accounts.name: owner_usdc
docs: The borrower's USDC (associated account, created by the cranker if needed), for a refund.

accounts.name: policy
docs: Gap Cover for the upcoming closure, if bought: the loan keeps max LTV through the Bell window.

accounts.name: payer
docs: The borrower buying cover, or anyone enforcing the Bell (pays the policy account's rent).

accounts.name: risk_set
docs: The risk set of the upcoming closure's type.

accounts.name: policy
docs: One policy per loan per closure: a second purchase fails here.

accounts.name: owner_usdc
docs: The borrower's USDC, when the premium is paid in cash.

errors.name: NotAdmin

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: FaucetCapExceeded
errors.msg: Faucet amount is above the per-call cap

errors.name: MintNotProtocolOwned
errors.msg: Mint is not controlled by the protocol

errors.msg: Risk parameters must satisfy closed LTV <= max LTV < liquidation threshold < 100%

errors.name: InvalidSymbol
errors.msg: Symbol must be 1 to 8 bytes

errors.name: InvalidPrice
errors.msg: Price must be greater than zero

errors.name: StalePrice
errors.msg: Price is older than the maximum allowed age

errors.name: InsufficientCollateral
errors.msg: Not enough collateral in the position

errors.name: BorrowLimitExceeded
errors.msg: Debt would exceed the borrow limit

errors.name: NoDebt
errors.msg: Position has no debt

errors.name: PositionHealthy
errors.msg: Position is healthy and cannot be liquidated

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

errors.name: InsufficientLiquidity
errors.msg: Not enough USDC liquidity in the market

errors.name: BorrowCapExceeded
errors.msg: Market borrow cap reached

errors.name: SupplyCapExceeded
errors.msg: Vault or market supply cap reached

errors.name: NotAllocator
errors.msg: Signer is not the vault allocator

errors.name: WrongMarketAccounts
errors.msg: Market accounts must be the vault's markets, in order

errors.name: TooManyMarkets
errors.msg: The vault already has the maximum number of markets

errors.name: InvalidQueue
errors.msg: Queue must list distinct vault market indexes

errors.name: WrongRedeemRequest

errors.name: RequestNotProcessed

errors.name: RequestAlreadyClaimed
errors.msg: Redeem request is already claimed

errors.name: VaultIlliquid
errors.msg: Not enough vault liquidity to redeem now; queue a redeem request instead

errors.name: ZeroShares

errors.name: ScenarioTailTooShort
errors.msg: The stored scenario tail is too short for this computation

errors.name: BorrowPaused

errors.name: ClosureOpenEnded

errors.name: MarketNotOpen

errors.name: CalendarFull

errors.name: WrongRiskSet

errors.name: InvalidScenarioSet

errors.name: SigmaDecreaseTooFast

errors.name: NotSigmaOracle

errors.name: InvalidRestriction

errors.name: NoOpenEpoch

errors.name: EpochNotSettleable

errors.name: CoverWindowClosed

errors.name: PoolCapacityExceeded

errors.name: NothingToClaim

errors.name: WrongAuctionPhase

errors.name: AuctionFull

errors.name: CostAboveMax

types.name: AssetClock
docs: Per-market clock (AssetClock `ClockData`): a lazy state machine advanced by `poke`.

fields.name: closure_id
docs: ++ at every scheduled close, halt or corporate action.

fields.name: venue_epoch
docs: Calendar index of the session whose close opened the current closure.

fields.name: closed_sessions
docs: Scheduled closes already opened (one closure per close, even across missed pokes).

fields.name: reopen_at
docs: Scheduled open that ends the current closure (0 = unknown).

fields.name: ref_price
docs: Last price at the close, frozen for the closure.

fields.name: open_print
docs: First price after the reopen, written once per closure.

fields.name: restriction
docs: Guardian restriction (Closed or Halted) until `restriction_until`.

types.name: Auction
docs: One uniform-price batch auction of a market's collateral (AuctionHouse `Auction` + market `LotInfo`).

fields.name: deadlines
docs: [lotFixAt, biddingStart, commitEnd/biddingEnd, clearAt], unix seconds.

fields.name: lot
docs: Q: collateral base units released by the fixed positions.

fields.name: reserve
docs: R: USDC base units per whole token (final at clearing for the open kinds).

fields.name: start_price
docs: V at creation (INTRADAY) or at lot fixing (PRECLOSE).

fields.name: proceeds
docs: USDC the lot raised (bidders at p* + the pool at R), attributed to positions as they settle.

fields.name: nav
docs: A T-Bill fund lot: reserve at κ_nav, the pool's backstop is redeemed with the fund (§8.8).

types.name: AuctionBook
docs: Per-market auction counter and the joinable auction of each kind (AuctionHouse.getOrCreate).

fields.name: intraday
docs: Joinable auctions (0 = none): INTRADAY by id; REOPEN / PRECLOSE also by the closure they belong to.

types.name: Bid
docs: A bid: sealed (REOPEN, commitment + bond, revealed later) or open (firm, escrowed now).

fields.name: price
docs: USDC base units per whole token.

fields.name: escrow
docs: USDC held for this bid (bond included).

types.name: Calendar
docs: Append-only sessions of one venue, precomputed off-chain in UTC (no timezone logic on-chain). Zero-copy:
a poke reads only the sessions it needs instead of decoding the whole year.

types.name: ClockState
docs: Most restrictive wins: CorpAction > Halted > Closed > Reopen > Extended > Regular.

fields.name: keeper
docs: Bot key allowed to push prices and toggle market sessions.

types.name: Epoch
docs: One closure of a pool (R-10), from its opening (before or in the Bell window) to its settlement after the reopen.
Zero-copy: the two 256-scenario loss vectors are read in place.

fields.name: seq
docs: Pool sequence number (1, 2, …).

fields.name: session
docs: Calendar index of the session whose close starts the closure.

fields.name: equity_at_risk
docs: J: pool NAV frozen at the Bell deadline (0 until the snapshot).

fields.name: settle_supply
docs: Share supply at settlement (with the escrowed withdrawal shares), the price denominator.

fields.name: policy_losses
docs: Σ of every policy's loss in each joint scenario.

fields.name: uncovered
docs: Σ over markets of the uncovered bound B_m,j.

types.name: EpochMarket
docs: One market's uncovered exposure in an epoch (refreshed by keepers and by every cover).

types.name: Gda
docs: A continuous gradual Dutch auction over inventory (F-4.5e): unit u becomes available at start + u / r and its
price decays from k at rate λ, floored at (1 − κ) × V.

fields.name: k
docs: k: USDC base units per whole token.

fields.name: decay
docs: λ, WAD per second.

fields.name: emission_per_sec
docs: r: token base units per second.

types.name: GuardianState
docs: Emergency controls (FinityGuardian): pauses and a temporary max-LTV haircut, held by a separate key.

fields.name: vault_cap
docs: How much the senior vault may supply to this market.

types.name: Inventory
docs: The pool's backstop inventory of one collateral token, held in the pool's associated token account (F-4.5e).

fields.name: qty
docs: Tokens held (including the part on sale in the running GDA).

fields.name: cost
docs: USDC the pool paid for `qty`.

fields.name: mark
docs: This inventory's share of `pool.inventory_mark`.

fields.name: nav
docs: A T-Bill fund (USBANK): redeemed with the fund instead of resold.

types.name: JointColumn
docs: An asset's column of the joint stress set (K scenarios, same row order for every asset).

types.name: LotEntry
docs: A position's place in a lot (LotEntry): x sold out of q_before, target LTV for a pre-close sale.

fields.name: target_ltv
docs: WAD; 0 = H* sizing (REOPEN / INTRADAY).

fields.name: price
docs: USDC base units per one whole collateral token.

fields.name: max_ltv_bps
docs: Borrow limit while the market is open.

fields.name: closed_ltv_bps
docs: Closure-safe borrow limit while the market is closed or halted.

fields.name: total_supply_assets
docs: Owed to the senior vault: its supply plus its share of interest.

fields.name: pool_fee_accrued
docs: Interest receivables of the underwriter pool and the treasury (R-09).

types.name: OracleConfig
docs: The price signers (relayer nodes) and the rules a signed report must meet.

fields.name: threshold
docs: k of n distinct signers must agree on a market's report set.

fields.name: keeper_price_allowed
docs: Devnet escape hatch: lets the keeper/admin `set_price` directly (off by default: prices come signed).

types.name: Policy
docs: Gap Cover bought by one loan for one closure.

fields.name: auto
docs: Written by the Bell (premium added to debt) rather than bought by the borrower.

types.name: PoolTicket
docs: A depositor's queued deposit or escrowed withdrawal for one epoch.

types.name: PositionLock
docs: One lot at a time per loan: set when the loan joins an auction, cleared when its
part of the lot settles.

types.name: ProtocolReserve
docs: Second loss layer, funded by the treasury's share of interest.

types.name: RateParams
docs: Kinked interest-rate model, WAD per year.

types.name: RedeemRequest
docs: A queued redemption (RedeemRequest): shares escrowed now, paid at the share price when processed.

types.name: Redemption
docs: A T-Bill redemption the pool requested from the fund for backstop inventory (§8.8): carried in NAV at `cost`
until it is claimed at the fund's NAV once the redemption is fulfilled.

types.name: RiskConfig
docs: Global risk parameters (RiskEngine `RiskParams`), WAD unless noted.

fields.name: sigma_oracle
docs: The only σ writer (SigmaOracle); the keeper on devnet.

fields.name: min_premium
docs: Loan base units.

types.name: RiskSet
docs: One (market, closure type): σ and the lowest scenarios of its calibrated set (R-14).

fields.name: n
docs: Size of the full calibrated set.

fields.name: scenario_hash
docs: Content hash of the full set, as published in the risk bundle.

fields.name: dividend
docs: Known dividend inside the closure, WAD fraction of price.

types.name: SeniorVault
docs: The senior lenders' vault: USDC in, shares out; supplies the markets up to their caps.

fields.name: idle
docs: Unallocated USDC (excludes processed-but-unclaimed redemptions).

fields.name: total_supplied
docs: Σ total_supply_assets of the vault's markets, kept in step with every accrual, supply and withdrawal.

fields.name: markets
docs: Enabled markets, in order; every instruction that values the vault takes them all as remaining accounts.

fields.name: supply_queue
docs: Indexes into `markets`.

types.name: Session
docs: Trading session of the underlying stock market.

types.name: SessionArg
docs: `append_sessions` argument (the stored record carries padding).

types.name: SessionRec
docs: One exchange session, UTC unix seconds (CalendarStore `Session`). Fixed layout: read in place, never decoded.

fields.name: closure_type_after
docs: Type of the closure that starts at `close` (1 overnight, 2 weekend, 3 holiday weekend).

types.name: UnderwriterPool
docs: Junior first-loss capital of one venue. Its USDC sits in the protocol vault; this is
its ledger. NAV = cash − unearned premiums − queued deposits − reserved withdrawals.

fields.name: unearned_premiums
docs: Premiums of the open epoch, earned at its settlement.

fields.name: deposits_queued
docs: Deposits waiting for the open epoch's settlement price.

fields.name: withdraw_reserved
docs: Settled withdrawals not yet claimed.

fields.name: next_withdraw_shares
docs: Withdrawal shares escrowed for the next epoch to be opened.

fields.name: epochs_opened
docs: Epochs opened so far; the open one (if any) is number `epochs_opened`.

fields.name: last_session
docs: Calendar index of the last epoch's close (an epoch is never opened twice for one closure).

fields.name: inventory_mark
docs: Backstop inventory at its mark, Σ min(qty × (1 − κ) × V, cost) as of each inventory's last touch (§8.6.1).

fields.name: claims_cost
docs: T-Bill redemption claims carried at what the pool paid for them (§8.8).

fields.name: redemptions
docs: Redemptions requested so far (the next one's id is this + 1).
